name: io.github.WYRE-AI/teramind-mcp
title: Teramind
description: MCP server for Teramind's insider-threat/employee-monitoring API (read-only, metadata-only surface).

environmentVariables.name: TERAMIND_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Teramind Access Token (JWT, generated in the dashboard's Access Tokens menu). See README's Credential scope section before minting one.

environmentVariables.name: TERAMIND_INSTANCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Per-instance Teramind dashboard base URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.teramind.co.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
